title: Generation of Library for Sequencing
author: Clémentine elan-Forino
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bntimeke
materials: To each sample, add 4 µL, 5× First Strand buffer (Invitrogen), 1 µL, 100 mM DTT , and 1 µL, RNasin .

steps.title: Prepare fresh dNTP dilution
steps.instruction: Make a fresh dNTP dilution (10 mM) immediately before reverse transcription or aliquot and store at –20 °C to avoid multiple thawings.

steps.title: Resuspend RNA pellet and add primers
steps.instruction: Resuspend the RNA pellet in 11 µL MilliQ water, add 1 µL 10 µM RT primer and 1 µL 10 mM dNTPs.

steps.title: Denature RNA and chill
steps.instruction: Heat the mixture at 80 °C for 3 min, then place on ice for 5 min; briefly centrifuge to collect the liquid.

steps.title: Add reverse transcriptase and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL SuperScript III (Invitrogen) and incubate at 50 °C for 3 min to dissociate nonspecific primers, then continue incubation at 50 °C for 1 h.

steps.title: Inactivate reverse transcriptase
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction at 65 °C for 15 min to inactivate SuperScript III.

steps.title: Digest RNA with RNase H
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL RNase H and incubate at 37 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Set up PCR master mix
steps.instruction: For each 50 µL PCR, combine 3 µL cDNA template with 47 µL master mix containing 5 µL 10× LA Taq buffer, 1 µL 10 µM P5 Solexa primer, 1 µL 10 µM pE_miRCat reverse primer, 5 µL fresh 10 mM dNTPs, 0.5 µL LA TaKaRa Taq polymerase, and 37.5 µL nuclease‑free water. Prepare at least three independent PCR reactions per sample.

steps.title: Perform PCR amplification
steps.instruction: Run PCR with the following program: 95 °C 2 min; 98 °C 20 s; then 21 cycles of 52 °C 20 s, 68 °C 20 s; final extension 72 °C 5 min.

steps.title: Pool PCR products and precipitate
steps.instruction: Pool the PCR reactions, add 0.1 volume sodium acetate (pH 5.2) and 2.5 volumes ice‑cold absolute ethanol (or use a MinElute PCR purification kit). Elute the purified DNA with 20 µL water.

steps.title: Ethanol precipitation and centrifugation
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at –20 °C for 30 min, then centrifuge at 16 000 × g, 4 °C for 30 min. Remove supernatant, air‑dry the pellet and resuspend in 15 µL MilliQ water.

steps.title: Prepare 3% Metaphor agarose gel
steps.instruction: Make a 3 % Metaphor agarose gel in 1× TBE containing 1:1000 SYBR Safe; soak agarose powder in 1× TBE for 30 min before stirring (or microwave), pour gel, and store at 4 °C wrapped in cling film for at least 30 min.

steps.title: Load samples onto gel
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL 6× DNA gel loading dye to the DNA sample, load the entire volume onto the gel together with a 50 bp DNA ladder.

steps.title: Run electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Run the gel at 80 V for ~2 h or until the bromophenol blue front is ~2 cm from the gel edge.

steps.title: Image gel and identify library band
steps.instruction: Image the gel using a Typhoon FLA9500 laser scanner at 1 : 1 scale; locate the smear above primer dimers (avoid the ~120 nt adapter‑dimer band).

steps.title: Excise library DNA from gel
steps.instruction: Place the gel on a transparent film, align with the scan, and excise the library region from the bottom of the smear up to the predefined upper limit with a sterile scalpel.

steps.title: Extract DNA from gel slices
steps.instruction: Transfer gel slices to 2 mL tubes, add 1 mL Buffer QG (MinElute Gel Extraction kit), incubate at 42 °C for 15–20 min to dissolve agarose.

steps.title: Bind DNA to MinElute column
steps.instruction: Transfer the solution to a MinElute column in a collection tube, spin at 16 000 × g for 1 min, discard flowthrough; repeat with remaining solution to bind all DNA to the same column.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer QG
steps.instruction: Add 750 µL Buffer QG, spin at 16 000 × g for 1 min, discard flowthrough.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer PE
steps.instruction: Add 750 µL Buffer PE (Qiagen), incubate at room temperature for 10 min, spin at 16 000 × g for 1 min, discard flowthrough.

steps.title: Dry column and elute DNA
steps.instruction: Spin the column at 16 000 × g, room temperature, for 2 min to dry; transfer column to a clean 1.5 mL tube, add 20 µL MilliQ water onto the membrane, let stand 2–5 min, then elute by spinning at 16 000 × g, room temperature, for 1 min.

steps.title: Quantify and store library
steps.instruction: Measure library concentration with a Qubit high‑sensitivity DNA assay kit and fluorometer; store the library at –20 °C.
